change_log: v46 (2026-06-30): TIME-AVERAGED OFI — build behind the dataset boundary, P4 #4 (docs/time-averaged-ofi-proposal.md, APPROVED 2026-06-29; §10 all-recommended + the tweaker-exposure directive). FIRST P4 scoring re-baseline upgrade — but THIS commit is the BUILD ONLY; the threshold re-derivation is a LATER data-gated pass (v47-ish), mirroring v36→v40. TWO new keys under indicators.OFI: averaging_enabled (true) + avg_window_sec (10). MECHANISM: on the live WS path the single-snapshot OFI is replaced by a TIME-WEIGHTED average of the top-book imbalance over the run window — a feed-side rolling accumulator (Core/OfiAccumulator.vb, host-agnostic) folds each ~100ms book update's weighted bid/ask imbalance into a time-AWARE **geometric (log-ratio)** EMA (Ratio = exp(EMA(ln ratio)); alpha = 1 - exp(-dt/tau), tau = avg_window_sec, applied in log space; NOT fixed-alpha — the window must mean what it says under irregular arrivals) — multiplicatively unbiased for the symmetric bid/ask ratio, chosen over arithmetic per the NY DIAG test (2026-06-30, commit eee6e4b, reverted): arithmetic gave a 12:1 buy-dominant skew on a net-flat 5.1h session vs 1.4:1 geometric (AM≥GM bias; see docs/ofi-geometric-construction-spec.md). The weighted bid/ask volumes (OFIBidVol/OFIAskVol, display context) stay arithmetic. The folded scalar is the SAME sanity-bounded weighted ratio CalcOFI computes (the math is now a shared pure helper IndicatorEngine.ComputeOfiImbalance + ClassifyOfiRatio, so CalcOFI is byte-identical), so the OFISignal classification, the _ofiHistory momentum ring, and the breakdown/card render are UNCHANGED in mechanism — only the VALUE of r.OFIRatio changes (averaged vs snapshot). ⚠ DATASET BOUNDARY: the analysis_log.csv OFIRatio/OFISignal/OFIBidVol/OFIAskVol columns keep their names but their SEMANTICS shift (averaged on the WS majority) — documented here + §15, NO header rotation (same rule as v31/v36). The v47-ish re-baseline re-derives buy_dominant_ratio (2.0) / sell_dominant_ratio (0.5) by firing-rate-matching to the snapshot-OFI history (v40/v41 method) once post-build data accumulates, since averaging tightens the ratio distribution and the spiky-snapshot thresholds would under-fire on it — that re-baseline (and the OFI.Momentum* review) now run on the GEOMETRIC distribution, not the arithmetic one this entry originally described. WARMUP/RESET: until the accumulator has >= avg_window_sec of fold coverage (+ a small min fold count) the run falls back to the snapshot CalcOFI; the accumulator resets on (re)connect so a stale pre-gap average can't bleed across — the fallback re-arms after every reconnect. WS-ONLY: at transport=rest or on a per-run REST fallback there is one book/run → snapshot CalcOFI (today's path; never blocks). TWEAKER SURFACE (trader directive): avg_window_sec is ON the surface (it shapes the OFI signal — a real failure-rate lever) alongside book_depth + the dominance ratios; only averaging_enabled (the feature on/off flag, not a threshold) is OFF — exact-match rejected in SettingsDiffApplier.Validate + PromptBuilder HARD CONSTRAINT 16 (siblings remain tunable). COUPLING CAVEAT: the dominance ratios are re-derived FOR a given window, so a manual avg_window_sec change should be followed by a ratio re-check (the iterative tweaker re-tunes over rounds). REVERSIBILITY: averaging_enabled=false reverts to snapshot OFI hot (the rollback) and is BYTE-IDENTICAL to v45 (proven via the harness regression). CODE: new Core/OfiAccumulator.vb (+ OfiAverageSnapshot struct); IndicatorEngine.ComputeOfiImbalance/ClassifyOfiRatio extracted from CalcOFI; MarketState owns the accumulator (FoldOfi/ResetOfiAccumulator/GetOfiAverage under its SyncLock); DeribitWsFeed folds on each book update + resets in SeedAsync (every connect); RunAnalysisAsync sources the OFI fields from the average on the WS-live path when warmed up. Display-parity: no new/removed/renamed rendered line — the OFI breakdown row + card binding render the same r.OFIRatio (value source unchanged), so no card-surface change. Acceptance: solution(Release) + AutoTweaker + OrderCheck build 0/0; A1-A19e unregressed + A20a-h (CalcOFI refactor byte-identical, EMA steady-state + time-aware step, warmup gate, reset re-arm, tweaker reject averaging_enabled / accept avg_window_sec) + new A20i (geometric symmetry: alternating 2.0/0.5 converges to ~1.0, not the ~1.25 an arithmetic mean would give); averaging_enabled=false byte-identical to v45. No CSV-schema/eval-cache change; CSV stays v0.7, eval cache v4. AMENDMENT (2026-07-01, docs/ofi-geometric-construction-spec.md): the ratio construction switched arithmetic → geometric (log-ratio) per the NY DIAG test — folds INTO this v46 entry, no version bump (dataset boundary lands on the final construction; v47 stays reserved for the data-gated threshold re-baseline).

Deliberately NOT a verdict (no score / no direction call — §11 discipline: the verdict stays a deliberate full-pipeline product; the strip shows raw microstructure INPUTS, visually distinct, so it informs without tempting a marginal entry). NEVER calls ScoringEngine.Calculate, never writes the CSV, no schema change, NO re-baseline. CODE: new host-agnostic LiveMicrostructureEvaluator.vb (Evaluate(state, lastRun, cfg) -> MicrostructureSnapshot — reuses the existing pure CalcTFI / CalcSpread / CalcOFI fns + carried last-run levels LastSwingHigh/Low5m + VPFRNearestHvnAbove/Below + a small tape-speed window scan; identical methodology to the full run, only fresher; never throws, degenerate/empty buffer -> safe blanks). Levels are CARRIED not recomputed (5m swing / VPFR HVN are slow, refresh each full run); price/TFI/spread/imbalance/tape-speed recomputed live. WinForms host = a ~2s System.Windows.Forms.Timer (MainForm_LiveStrip.vb; created at form load, disposed on close; self-gates each tick — renders only when enabled AND the WS feed is healthy+fresh; transport=rest / no _marketState -> 'TAPE · WS only') + a thin full-width TAPE strip row directly under the verdict header (neutral/dim, never the verdict colour ramp) + a VISIBLE 'TAPE' checkbox toggle for live_strip.enabled (mirrors the SINGLE/REPEAT + INTERVAL/ON-CLOSE radio toggles; data label hides when off so 'disabled→hidden' (§7) holds while the toggle stays reachable (§10)). ALWAYS-ON when enabled (NOT position-gated — useful flat watching a level for entry or in a hold), independent of the exit-guard timer + the on-close watcher. OFF the auto-tweaker surface: 'live_strip.' added to SettingsDiffApplier.RejectedPathPrefixes + PromptBuilder HARD CONSTRAINT 15 (display preference, no failure-rate linkage — same class as kelly.*/exit_guard.*/auto_run.*). Live status-bar element like BuildWsStatusSegment / the exit-guard strip — NOT an RTF/snapshot/card surface, so no card-binding obligation (engine display-string parity rule). Runtime toggle saves bumpVersion:=False (operational); only this one-time key ADD bumps v44->v45. Acceptance: solution(Release) + AutoTweaker + OrderCheck build 0/0; A1-A18e unregressed (engine path untouched — the strip never calls Calculate) + new A19a-e evaluator fixtures (TFI/spread/imbalance correct, nearest-level above-vs-below selection, tape-speed window [recent counted / older excluded / lull -> 0], empty buffer -> blanks no throw); transport=rest / disabled -> strip inert, verdict path byte-identical. No CSV/eval-cache change; CSV stays v0.7, eval cache v4. §9 #1 checkpoint (overall look) CLEARED 2026-06-29 (default->enabled:true + visible checkbox toggle); §9 #4 (both-levels) behaves as designed — the strip shows the NEAREST level on EACH side, so when price is below ALL carried structure (a strong down-leg that broke the 5m swing low) only the nearest-above shows and the below-bracket is genuinely empty until the next full run maps a level there.

Shared, UI-editable, hot-reloadable, OFF the auto-tweaker surface (trader risk preference, same exclusion class as kelly.*; new HARD CONSTRAINT 11 in PromptBuilder). (1) SCORING GATE (behaviour change, approval-gated): at the end of Calculate() after Step 5b, a directional verdict whose EFFECTIVE (post-cap) take-profit distance < min_tradeable_move_pct x price is overridden to NO TRADE with VerdictContext = BELOW_MIN_MOVE; scores/breakdown/levels preserved for display. Catches both low-ATR (small ATR target) and near-swing (cap pulls TP below floor) causes. At ~$62k low-vol this suppresses most Asia (ATR ~13) and low-ATR NY verdicts BY DESIGN -> slower low-vol accumulation, cleaner calibration book. (2) EVAL DE-CONFOUND (analysis-layer; no scoring votes/thresholds/vetoes touched): favourable barrier floored at max(k x ATR, min_tradeable_move_pct x price) so 'success' requires a tradeable move; gate-killed historical directional trades (AtrTargetMultiplier x ATR < floor) reclassified EXCLUDED_BELOW_MIN_MOVE and removed from success/fail counts (NOT re-scored as failures, mirroring the live gate), survivors still scored with the floor. Eval cache schema v2 -> v3 (re-evaluate on load; store the floor pct used; re-walk if it changes). One-time forensic logs how many directional trades got excluded and how many were SUCCESS under the old confounded barrier. Both must land before the supervised auto-tweaker first fire. No CSV scoring-schema change (VerdictContext already logged; BELOW_MIN_MOVE rides existing column). Acceptance: harness A13a/b/c + editability; eval before/after Asia-ATR table in spec-back.
